supportEnvelope.basis: manually selected visible ground-support extremities: left masonry footing, frontmost left entrance-step tip, right entrance-step outer footing. Includes both entrance stairs. These points are an asymmetric logical placement envelope, not three proven rectangle corners; the unexposed wall-front corner and rear corner remain unmeasured. About +/-10px.

W.basis: visible W-parallel rear roof silhouette; first alpha>=220 pixel per x, x=880..970; source SOURCES.md fit slope +0.47331, RMSE 0.303px

D.basis: visible D-parallel rear roof silhouette; first alpha>=220 pixel per x, x=450..630; source SOURCES.md fit slope -0.28052, RMSE 0.299px

heightReference.basis: visible front-left main masonry corner, manually selected ground footing and roof cornice on the same vertical; approximate visual H1 ruler, excludes chimney and front steps; about +/-10px

notes: crop is the half-open absolute source-pixel bbox of alpha>8; PNG is 1254x1254 and is unchanged.
anchor is the manually selected frontmost entrance-step ground contact, about +/-5px; it is not a claim that the staircase tip is a footprint corner.
axes are keyed W and D, both with increasing source x; D is reported toward upper-right. Endpoint slope can differ slightly from the least-squares fit.
Ground rear corner is hidden; no visible four-corner footprint is asserted. The unequal roof axes do not prove a physical 1x1 ground square.
Calibration is a render-time coordinate mapping, not a modification of the PNG. targetHeight=1 is a visual unit, not a measured storey height.

supportEnvelope.basis: manually selected left outer entry planter-plinth contact, foremost entry-paving tip and right outer planter-plinth contact. heightReference.basis: visible front-right stone corner tower, manually selected low footing and main cap on the same vertical; approximate visual H1 facade ruler, excludes tall rear tower and arched-roof apex; about +/-10px

anchor is the frontmost entry-paving ground contact, manually selected within about +/-5px; the actual wall corner is offset from this paving tip.
axes are keyed W and D with increasing source x; D points toward upper-right. D uses a straight roof edge because the right ground edge is repeatedly interrupted by planters and piers.
